scope.source: every recorded paper_strategy_trade with a direction at least four hours old, grouped by its original paper strategy batch
scope.label: mid-price at the final completed M15 close at or before four hours later is above or below the final completed M15 close at or before the recorded decision
scope.meaning: direction-only audit of the actual batch decision; not a P&L result, trade replay, or proof that a later price direction was executable
scope.ruleClassification: EMA, momentum and breakout are labelled directional; meanrev is labelled reversal; missing family metadata is legacy-or-unspecified
scope.excludes: all trade writes, stop/target changes, inversion shortcuts, and post-result rule changes
